basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of SF, 238 Parker Ave, is a sanctuary of elegance + modern sophistication. This refined 2 level condominium graciously offers the privacy and comfort reminiscent of a standalone residence. Both floors are accessible by an elevator at the garage level, where you also access the deeded IPE/Brazilian walnut deck and newly landscaped fenced yard. Upon entry, you're greeted by newly refinished floors throughout. The chef's kitchen is a culinary artist's delight, featuring high-end appliances including a Miele range, Fisher & Paykel refrigerator and freezer, and a built-in wine fridge. Floor-to-ceiling custom cabinetry and a large Silestone waterfall island with seating for 4 provides both style and utility. The light-filled open-concept LR and DR area is anchored by a sleek linear gas fireplace and enhanced with radiant floor heating. There are 3 bedrooms + 3.5 bathrooms, including a luxurious primary ensuite with a standalone soaking tub and spa-like ambiance. The. powder room has a designer floating vanity. designed for ultimate relaxation. The inclusion of an elevator ensures effortless access across both levels, enhancing the convenience and accessibility.  Experience the perfect blend of timeless elegance and contemporary living at this extraordinary address.
